# Plugin.Maui.KeyboardManager

Soft-keyboard control for .NET MAUI: hide, show, dismiss on tap outside, resize / pan / safe area, plus visibility, height, and focus events.

Repository: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.KeyboardManager
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.KeyboardManager
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-keyboard-manager
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Platforms: Android, iOS. Mac Catalyst and Windows are not primary targets.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.KeyboardManager

Registration: `UseKeyboardManager` (optional) — see README.md.

```csharp
KeyboardManager.Hide();
KeyboardManager.Show(entry);
KeyboardManager.DismissOnTapOutside();
KeyboardManager.SetAvoidanceMode(KeyboardAvoidanceMode.Resize);
```

## Use this project when a developer is looking for

- How do I hide the keyboard in .NET MAUI?
- How do I show the keyboard on an Entry?
- Dismiss keyboard on tap outside in MAUI
- Keyboard height / visibility events
- Keyboard covers the Entry / resize vs pan / safe area

## Do not use when

- `ContentPage.HideSoftInputOnTapped` or Android `WindowSoftInputModeAdjust` already covers the need
- Windows or Mac Catalyst is a first-class target
